projects.title: AI Business Analyst
projects.tagline: 8 LangGraph tool-calling agents with structured outputs, hybrid RAG knowledge layer, and automated business KPI profiling.
projects.description: A production AI analyst that ingests CSV/XLSX business data, automatically profiles datasets, computes KPIs, detects trends and anomalies, finds correlations, and answers business questions through 8 LangGraph tool-calling agents with structured outputs.

projects.title: Production RAG System
projects.tagline: End-to-end document Q&A pipeline with Gemini embeddings, ChromaDB, BM25 hybrid search, and RRF re-ranking.
projects.description: Production document Q&A system featuring PDF/DOCX ingestion, recursive chunking, ChromaDB vector storage, BM25 hybrid search, and SSE streaming.

projects.title: GPT From Scratch
projects.tagline: Decoder-only Transformer implemented from first principles in PyTorch with custom multi-head attention and training loops.
projects.description: Pure PyTorch implementation of a GPT decoder-only Transformer with causal masked self-attention and empirical training loops.
